title: Tito Learns to Try
moral: Trying something new can be scary but also wonderful.

scenes.summary: Tito the chick watches others play but is afraid to try new things.
scenes.text:
Tito the Chick Who Was Afraid to Try

In a sunny farmyard, lived a tiny yellow chick named Tito.

Tito loved watching others do amazing things.

The ducklings swam.

The lambs jumped.

The puppies ran fast.

But Tito mostly just… watched.
scenes.image_prompt: cute yellow chick watching other animals play in sunny farmyard, colorful cartoon style

scenes.summary: Tito is afraid to join others because he fears failure.
scenes.text:
“Come play with us!” said Dolly the Duckling.

“Try jumping!” said Lily the Lamb.

But Tito shook his head.

“What if I fall?” he said.

“What if I can’t do it?”

So Tito stayed in his little corner.
scenes.image_prompt: shy chick staying back while duckling and lamb invite him to play, farmyard cartoon scene

scenes.summary: Tito watches others paint and begins to think about trying.
scenes.text:
One day, the farmer brought out colorful paints.

“Let’s make art!” the animals cheered.

They dipped their feet and paws into paint.

Splash! Tap! Stamp!

They made bright and funny patterns.

Tito watched from afar.

“That looks fun,” he said quietly.

Tito looked at his tiny feet.

“Maybe I can try…” he whispered.

Then he stopped.

“What if I make a mess?”

He stepped back again.
scenes.image_prompt: animals painting with colorful footprints while chick watches unsure, bright playful cartoon

scenes.summary: Maya encourages Tito to try, and he takes his first step into the paint.
scenes.text:
Just then, Maya the Hen came over.

“Why don’t you try, Tito?” she asked kindly.

“I’m scared,” Tito said.

Maya smiled.

“It’s okay to be scared,” she said.

“But trying is how you learn.”

Tito took a deep breath.

He stepped into the paint.

Squish!

He lifted his foot and stamped it on the paper.

Tap!

A tiny yellow footprint appeared.

Tito blinked.

“I did it!” he chirped.
scenes.image_prompt: little chick stepping into paint and making first footprint while hen encourages, cheerful cartoon

scenes.summary: Tito gains confidence and happily joins others in making art.
scenes.text:
Soon, Tito was stamping, hopping, and making colorful art with everyone.

He laughed and played happily.

“I was scared before,” he said,

“but trying made it fun!”

Trying something new can be scary.

But it can also be wonderful.

The End

story:
Tito the Chick Who Was Afraid to Try

In a sunny farmyard, lived a tiny yellow chick named Tito.

Tito loved watching others do amazing things.

The ducklings swam.

The lambs jumped.

The puppies ran fast.

But Tito mostly just… watched.

“Come play with us!” said Dolly the Duckling.

“Try jumping!” said Lily the Lamb.

But Tito shook his head.

“What if I fall?” he said.

“What if I can’t do it?”

So Tito stayed in his little corner.

One day, the farmer brought out colorful paints.

“Let’s make art!” the animals cheered.

They dipped their feet and paws into paint.

Splash! Tap! Stamp!

They made bright and funny patterns.

Tito watched from afar.

“That looks fun,” he said quietly.

Tito looked at his tiny feet.

“Maybe I can try…” he whispered.

Then he stopped.

“What if I make a mess?”

He stepped back again.

Just then, Maya the Hen came over.

“Why don’t you try, Tito?” she asked kindly.

“I’m scared,” Tito said.

Maya smiled.

“It’s okay to be scared,” she said.

“But trying is how you learn.”

Tito took a deep breath.

He stepped into the paint.

Squish!

He lifted his foot and stamped it on the paper.

Tap!

A tiny yellow footprint appeared.

Tito blinked.

“I did it!” he chirped.

Soon, Tito was stamping, hopping, and making colorful art with everyone.

He laughed and played happily.

“I was scared before,” he said,

“but trying made it fun!”

Trying something new can be scary.

But it can also be wonderful.

The End
